text: T284 is blocked: Stop condition hit. Only existing marker-removal path is Writer.tsx deleteEmptyNote (line ~820) + App.tsx onFootnoteDelete (~1803): Backspace on an EMPTY, source-less footnote in the footnote area of the entry open in the editor; it deletes marker and record in one revision, no snapshot. Nothing removes a marker for a footnote that has text (e.g. 'lkdjlwakjd' in the owner's screenshot), for one whose marker is in a section not open (the 'in Angela Demonstration Fragment' rows), or from the Research panel. Panel 'Delete note' (ResearchPanel deleteNote) and removeSource only touch records, never document text. A Delete that removes markers from text/other sections would be new behaviour on the owner's writing (needs a cross-entry marker-removal op + safety snapshot + decision on whether notes with text may be deleted). No files changed. Owner decision needed.
resolution: Owner, 2026-11-11: 'full delete -- not empty only but show a confirm delete of some kind.' Delete works on any text-only footnote (with or without text, in any section, open or not): it removes the marker from the document and the footnote, after a confirmation step and a safety snapshot.
